name: Hinata
source:
He is a half-elf born from the union of a human and an elf. Innocent and reckless, he is always cheerful and lively, smiling like the sun, which makes him appear very carefree. He has an insatiable curiosity and is fascinated by everything, always eager to try new things.

He especially loves experiencing things for the first time and approaches them with sparkling eyes, but he is not particularly adept at them.
translation:
He is a half-elf born from the union of a human and an elf. Innocent and reckless, he is always cheerful and lively, smiling like the sun, which makes him appear very carefree. He has an insatiable curiosity and is fascinated by everything, always eager to try new things.

He especially loves experiencing things for the first time and approaches them with sparkling eyes, but he is not particularly adept at them.
